prospective_start_rule: bootstrap at the latest existing closed M15 row and accept only a later newly appended closed M15 row

state_grammar.session: decision_time hour: S01 before 08:00, S08 before 15:00, otherwise S15
state_grammar.h1_h4_alignment: UP when close > EMA20 > EMA50 on both last fully closed H1 and H4; DOWN when close < EMA20 < EMA50 on both; otherwise MIXED
state_grammar.volatility: current M15 ATR14 versus prior 5760 closed-M15 ATR14 tertiles
state_grammar.momentum: (current close - close four M15 rows earlier) / current ATR14; UP >= 0.50, DOWN <= -0.50, otherwise FLAT
state_grammar.expansion: current M15 high-low divided by prior 96 closed-M15 range median; COMP <= 0.80, EXP >= 1.50, otherwise NORM
state_grammar.candle_type: BULL or BEAR when absolute body/range >= 0.60; otherwise WEAK

entry.entry_time: exact signal_time plus 15 minutes M1 open

episode_rearm.rearm: M1 position has exited and the same exact state was absent for two consecutive closed M15 rows

exit.same_bar_priority: initial SL first; after partial, BE before final TP on later bars

monthly_health.decision_time: first eligible entry decision for each state in each new MT5 calendar month
monthly_health.history: same half-year, same state/action, actually executed prospective trades only
monthly_health.resolved_requirement: both M1 and M5 exit_time strictly before decision_time
monthly_health.suspend_if: cumulative M1 net <= 0 OR cumulative M5 net <= 0
monthly_health.duration: remainder of the current calendar half-year
monthly_health.bootstrap: empty result history; no pre-cutoff backfill

discord.default_source: read existing local V19 webhook configuration
